title: AI-Toolkit Adapter Manifest
description: The flat 'clips' shape expected by training.training_run preflight and ai-toolkit staging. This is what the 'ai-toolkit-ltx' manifest adapter exports from the canonical manifest.

clips.description: Flat list of training clips with caption sidecars.

clip_id.description: Unique clip identifier. Derived from file stem if absent.

clip_file.description: Repo-root-relative path to the clip media file. Primary field for training preflight.

path.description: Alias for clip_file. Training preflight falls back to this if clip_file is absent.

caption_file.description: Repo-root-relative path to the sibling caption JSON sidecar: <clip_id>.caption.json.

bucket.description: Dataset bucket this clip belongs to.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the clip file.

vocabulary_path.description: Optional path to the vocabulary YAML used for captioning.

generated_at.description: When this adapter manifest was generated.

source_manifest.description: Path to the canonical manifest this was derived from.
